description: Drum bus glue preset. Gentle bus comp first for cohesion, then EQ shaping. Light touch; a couple dB moves a lot.
name: drum-glue
notes: Precondition: Drums group track selected in Cubase, kit tracks routed to it, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/drum-glue.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Slot 0 may use a dedicated bus comp plugin instead of stock Compressor.
Send slot 0 -> short ambience FX, slot 1 -> long hall FX (assign destinations in Cubase one-time setup).
Air shelf boost is manual (band-specific gain needs the resolved title from the response param field).
